findings.text: follow-on: owner_age is set only on the row that first loads a foreign owner's profile (line 836) and appended only when that same row's shape yields a wall (line 844), so a foreign project with two live local workers whose earlier row matches no profile group reports expected_wait_profile_age_s null, or drops that owner from the maximum, though its profile contributed a wall on the later row.

follow-on: the base arm's header records its command with a prose tree description and <scratch> and $T placeholders rather than the literal invocation, so the arm's own record does not let a later reader reproduce the run.

justifications.fit: the added names PROFILE_MAX_AGE_S, refresh_run_time_profile and expected_wait_profile_age_s are mechanism names in the surrounding style of lane_context.py:559 and carry no plan label, ticket number or version.
justifications.goal_fidelity: lane_context.py:678-716 returns ({}, None) rather than building for a cold cache, a moved stamp past the bound, a ledger with no stamp and an unsafe project id, so a pick never reaches run_time_profile, and the rebuild is reached only from promotion.py:1248.
justifications.reuse: the diff reuses capabilities._read_pick_entry, cached_pick_input_rekeyed and pick_input_cache_path and extends the existing _profile_stamp, _profile_filename and _profile_cache_root owners rather than forking them; the search over reckon/crew/picker found no existing aged profile reader.
